body.p: The Office Action mailed December 21, 2023 has been carefully considered.
The Official Action asserts the pending claims include more than one species of a generic invention and identifies the following species:
(a) A textile comprising of the system of claim 1, with the following subspecies:
(i) A bandage comprising the textile of claim 14, and (ii) A garment comprising the textile of claim 14; and
(b) A handheld probe comprising the system of claim 1.
The Official Action requires election of "a single species to which the claims shall be restricted if no generic claim is finally held to be allowable" See Official Action, page 3.

Applicant hereby elects to prosecute species (a), a textile comprising the system of claim 1, and sub-species (ii), a garment comprising the textile of claim 1, without traverse. Claims 1-3, 5-8, 11, 14-15 and 17-23 read on the elected species and subspecies, i.e., a textile that is a garment. No separate lack of unity has been identified in the official action regarding claim 1 and method claim 19. As such, the applicant respectfully submits method claims 19-23 read on the elected species.
If the Examiner desires personal contact for further disposition of this case, the Examiner is invited to call the undersigned Attorney at 603.668.6560.
